name: Upcoming Movie Radar
description: Find one not-yet-emailed upcoming movie that matches a required genre request, enrich it with TMDB metadata and current public-web context, maintain one rolling Canvas page, and optionally email the pick with a public TMDB poster URL. Example: /upcoming_movie_radar science fiction, exclude animation and anime, next 90 days, email me the pick.

variables.tmdb_attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

steps.description: Find the durable Upcoming Movie Radar Canvas page
Open the persistent sent-movie history space
Load TMDB IDs that this workflow has already emailed

steps.abort_speech: Upcoming Movie Radar needs a recognized included genre and an available TMDB movie match. Try a request such as science fiction, exclude animation and anime, next 90 days.
steps.description: Discover upcoming TMDB matches with provider-side genre exclusion and persistent sent-ID filtering
Enrich the selected movie with cast, crew, production, certification, artwork, and videos

params.query: Current verified reporting about ${top_title} ${top_year}: release timing, production, principal cast, audience or critic discussion, and announced US theatrical or streaming plans. Preference request: ${movie_criteria}

steps.description: Optionally enrich the selected movie with current public-web reporting
Create the durable radar Canvas page on the first run
Refresh the durable radar page as a bounded full replacement
Optionally email the selected movie with its public TMDB poster and destination URL

steps.abort_speech: The movie email was sent, but Jarvis could not record ${top_title} in the sent-history ledger. Do not rerun the email workflow until the Stash acknowledgement is repaired, or it may send the same movie again.
steps.description: Acknowledge the TMDB ID only after the email webhook reports sent

success_speech: Upcoming Movie Radar complete. ${top_title} is the latest eligible pick, and the rolling Canvas page is current.
partial_speech: Upcoming Movie Radar completed with the TMDB and optional enrichment sources that were available. Check Canvas for ${top_title}; if email was requested, verify the email webhook result.
abort_speech: Upcoming Movie Radar could not find an eligible result. Include a recognized genre such as science fiction, make sure TMDB is configured, or widen the future release window.
